runtime.name: Official Cyberbotics Webots R2025b nightly_16_10_2026
runtime.execution: Official DMG mounted read-only; no binary patch.

world_assets: Version-pinned official R2025a PROTO URLs, unchanged world template.
design: 3 requested cruise targets (5, 10, 15 m/s) x 3 initial reference clearances (20, 40, 80 m); every run starts from rest; world randomSeed=1.
before: Nine executions of the previous published controller; all timed out without driving after unavailable startup speed triggered a permanent brake response.
after: Same nine configurations with a <=1 s, zero-cruise/full-brake initialization hold requiring 3 consecutive valid samples; later faults latch zero cruise/full brake.
repeat: The first corrected matrix is also retained. The primary after matrix was rerun after correcting a source docstring; identical world seed and controller behavior. This is a repeatability check, not nine independent trials.
acceptance: Existing movement, braking, stop, no-contact and >=3 m reference-distance requirements; unavailable startup samples are counted separately only during a bounded braked hold with <0.05 m independently measured X movement.
distance_definition: Obstacle front-face X minus vehicle reference X; not bumper clearance. Contact is separately measured by Webots contact points.
limits: Nine deterministic design points, not independent random trials or statistical safety evidence.
Requested targets are not initial speeds and are not all reached. No 15 m/s emergency-braking claim.
One static obstacle, straight road, single world seed; no physical vehicle, moving-obstacle physics, weather, injected physics faults, friction sweep or certification.
The earlier 1,836-run kinematic stress report uses its recorded earlier source revision and remains a separate software-model experiment.
Before/after source archives contain exact executed controllers/runner and all generated case worlds/configs. Historical results are preserved separately.
